injuries.name: Jayson Tatum

injuries.name: Derrick White
injuries.detail: White (shoulder) is questionable to play in Saturday's game against Sacramento.

injuries.name: P.J. Washington
injuries.detail: Washington (shoulder) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game versus the Clippers.

injuries.name: Walter Clayton Jr.
injuries.detail: Clayton (knee) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Clippers.

injuries.name: Dereck Lively II
injuries.detail: Head coach Dusty May said Friday that Lively (foot) is moving well and progressing in his recovery, and the big man told May he's "close" to returning, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

injuries.name: Sergio de Larrea
injuries.detail: De Larrea (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.

injuries.name: Tobi Lawal
injuries.detail: Lawal (groin) is out for Saturday's game against the Clippers.

injuries.name: Tarik Biberovic
injuries.detail: Biberovic (heel) is out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.

injuries.name: Cameron Boozer
injuries.detail: Boozer is out for Saturday's game against Minnesota due to a right ankle sprain.

injuries.name: Ty Jerome
injuries.detail: Jerome (hip) is probable for Saturday's game in Minnesota.

injuries.name: Javon Small
injuries.detail: Small won't play Saturday against the Timberwolves due to personal reasons.

injuries.name: Jerami Grant
injuries.detail: Grant (calf) is out for Saturday's game against the Timberwolves.

injuries.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
injuries.detail: Pippen (back) is progressing in his recovery but is still considered week-to-week.

injuries.name: GG Jackson
injuries.detail: Jackson underwent a procedure Wednesday to repair a broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot. He is expected to recover fully and will be re-evaluated in approximately three months.

injuries.name: Richie Saunders
injuries.detail: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Ousmane Dieng
injuries.detail: Dieng will undergo a procedure to repair a fractured left finger Monday, Justin Garcia of the Milwaukee Bucks Radio Network reports.

injuries.name: Anthony Edwards
injuries.detail: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

injuries.name: Donte DiVincenzo
injuries.detail: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Jaylen Clark
injuries.detail: Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.

injuries.name: Dejounte Murray
injuries.detail: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

injuries.name: Bennedict Mathurin
injuries.detail: Mathurin (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Thunder.

injuries.name: Bryce McGowens
injuries.detail: McGowens (elbow) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Thunder.

injuries.name: Trendon Watford
injuries.detail: Watford (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Oklahoma City.

injuries.name: OG Anunoby
injuries.detail: Anunoby (calf) has been downgraded to doubtful for Saturday's game against the Trail Bllazers.

injuries.name: Karl-Anthony Towns
injuries.detail: Towns is questionable for Saturday's game against the Trail Blazers due to an illness.

injuries.name: Jordan Clarkson
injuries.detail: Clarkson (foot) won't play in Saturday's game against Portland.

injuries.name: Tyrese Maxey
injuries.detail: Maxey (foot) will be a true game-time decision for Saturday's game against the Bucks, head coach Nick Nurse told Ky Carlin of USA Today.

injuries.name: Jaylen Brown
injuries.detail: Brown (hamstring) went through individual work during Friday's practice, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Dean Wade
injuries.detail: Wade (hamstring) won't play Saturday against the Bucks.

injuries.name: Dominick Barlow
injuries.detail: Barlow (back) is probable for Saturday's game versus the Bucks.

injuries.name: Adem Bona
injuries.detail: Bona (back) participated in Friday's practice, though he still needs to go through a full practice with contact before being cleared to return to game action, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

injuries.name: Ariel Hukporti
injuries.detail: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Deni Avdija
injuries.detail: Avdija (foot) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Knicks.

injuries.name: Ja Morant

injuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
injuries.detail: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Vit Krejci
injuries.detail: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Chris Youngblood
injuries.detail: Youngblood (heel) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Knicks.

injuries.name: Tobias Harris
injuries.detail: Harris (calf) is likely to be sidelined until early December, per Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio.

injuries.name: Dylan Harper
injuries.detail: Harper (hip) is expected to miss two to three weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Jayden Quaintance
injuries.detail: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Maxime Raynaud
injuries.detail: Raynaud (knee) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Suns.

injuries.name: Precious Achiuwa
injuries.detail: Achiuwa (lower leg) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Lakers.

injuries.name: Ben Simmons
injuries.detail: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
